# Google Veo

2 models in this family. Riftland's director asks them with one shared prompt guide; each card says what is specific to its model.

| Model | Kind | Best for | Card |
|---|---|---|---|
| Veo 3.1 | video | Scenes with dialogue that must match the picture; Atmosphere: ambience and sound effects as part of the shot; Cinematic, realistic shots described in film language | [model-veo-3-1.md](model-veo-3-1.md) |
| Veo 3.1 Fast | video | Rehearsing a shot before the final render; Quick tries of a prompt, a camera move or a line of dialogue; Scenes with dialogue and ambience | [model-veo-3-1-fast.md](model-veo-3-1-fast.md) |

## Choosing inside the family

- **Veo 3.1:** The full Veo: use it for the final version. The fast sibling has the same clock and sound, so rehearse there and finish here.
- **Veo 3.1 Fast:** The quick Veo: use it to try ideas. Finish on the full sibling for the final version.

## Pick something else when

- **Veo 3.1:** Clips longer than a short beat: pick a model built for long clips.
- **Veo 3.1 Fast:** The final version of an important clip: finish on the full model.
